ex.s: The vehicle — named the Transition – has two seats, four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.

ex.s: The Transition, which flew at 1,400 feet for eight minutes last month, can reach around 70 miles per hour on the road and 115 in the air.
ex.t: Transition上个月以1400英尺的高度飞行了8分钟，在公路上时速可达70英里左右，在空中可达115英里。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 大约有100人已经支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时购买，这些数字很可能在本周晚些时候Terrafugia在纽约车展上向公众介绍Transition后还会增加。

ex.s: The Transition is now going through crash tests to make sure it meets federal safety standards.
ex.t: Transition目前正在接受碰撞测试，以确保符合联邦安全标准。

ex.s: Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find redatively easy to meet.
ex.t: Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会发现这个要求相对容易达到。

ex.s: Good transitions highlight the ideas that connect different paragraphs and bring the text together as a whole.
ex.t: 好的过渡句能凸显连接各段落的思想，把全文凝聚成一个整体。

ex.s: Transitions can help readers understand how paragraphs work together, how they relate to one another, and how they build to a larger point.
ex.t: 过渡句能帮助读者理解各段落如何协同、彼此有何关联，以及如何共同支撑一个更大的观点。

ex.s: In addition to participation in school, a part-time job – such as working in a café or in an office administration role – can also be helpful in this transition.

ex.s: The transition from the 1980s to the 1990s was a time of great change in the world, and the Chinese were in danger of being dragged into a confusing debate about the rights and wrongs of the Cold War.
ex.t: 从 20 世纪 80 年代到 90 年代的过渡是世界巨变的时代，而中国人正面临被卷入关于冷战是非的混乱争论的危险。
